senses.gloss: m. (b. h.; = בעל פ׳, v. Del. Assyr. Handw. p. 519; פחה to be large, grandee, high officer, governor.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:3:5">Y. Bets. IV, 62ᶜ</cite> (R. Ḥiya addressing Rab) <he>בן פי׳ אחריהם</he> son of nobility, follow them (the example of thy kindred)!—Pl. <cite ref="Q00457"><he>פַּחוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 3:3">Bicc. III, 3</cite> <he>הפ׳ הסגנים וכ׳</he> the grandees, the chiefs, and the treasurers (of the Temple) went out to meet them.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14">Num. R. s. 14</cite>; a. e.
